name: Sol HQ app
mission: Publish Sol HQ as a real app on Replit and GitHub, with a registry any new body can join and numbers that stay true on their own.

name: Seed raise, January 2027
mission: A proper seed round that funds 12 to 18 months. Needs profitability in sight, the investor desk and the data room.

name: Match money by Nov 20
mission: $30K to $60K of match funds committed by Nov 20 so blocked deals can launch. The one constraint on revenue.

name: Year-end match pilot
mission: $750 pilot credited toward the $5K plan, with the 5% relative-lift guarantee. No percentage fees.

name: Nonprofit POWER 2026
mission: The conference: P2P matching demo and the TNL recording table.

name: Revenue-only freeze to Jan 31
mission: Only revenue work until Jan 31. Lifted for Sol HQ only on Oct 26 by Pooya.
